plan.archetype: Efficient early damage into poison and dexterity
plan.bossPrep: Secure reliable damage, poison scaling, efficient block, and sustained Weak. Upgrade core cards and preserve HP and potions; the threshold stun does not end the fight.
plan.summary: Take early damage before speculative synergy, then build poison and defense. Remove basics after replacing their roles. Use Boots for valuable routes and emergency campfires; fight elites when adequately prepared.

plan.archetype: Poison scaling with efficient defense and sustained Weak
plan.bossPrep: Upgrade Accelerant or Neutralize, improve efficient block, and acquire defensive potions. Poison must carry through the threshold stun into the boss’s second phase.
plan.summary: Keep the shop route and save Boots. Existing poison supplies scaling; prioritize defense, draw, and Weak. Remove Strikes only after replacing their damage. Heal now; upgrade a core card at the final campfire if healthy.

plan.archetype: Poison scaling supported by dexterity, draw, and sustained Weak
plan.bossPrep: Upgrade Accelerant, Noxious Fumes, and Neutralize. Add efficient block and draw; preserve defensive potions. Play escapes to maintain sandpit while surviving attacks.
plan.summary: Take free opening energy to deploy poison and defense quickly. Shop for dexterity and draw, then spend one Boots charge reaching four campfires. Upgrade core scaling when healthy; avoid additional elites.
